obligations.target: apfs-format / checked geometry and object header
obligations.property: Every admitted block range, count, object header and checksum window bounded; required unknown flags rejected before traversal.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Kani full-width scalars + 0..8 entries, real object sizes via fuzz; checksum primitive independently tested.
obligations.negative_witness: invalid block count causes large allocation or offset wrap

obligations.property: Selected checkpoint is complete under qualified profile, validates descriptors/mappings/checksums and uses consistent XID; newest incomplete candidate not silently selected.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: TLC 3 candidates, 2 descriptor ring slots (plus larger fixtures), torn/missing descriptors, valid fallback explicitly allowed, not infer complete solely from XID.
obligations.negative_witness: newest NXSB checksum valid but missing referenced checkpoint map

obligations.property: Virtual object resolves to visible version at requested XID (or qualified tombstone); physical/ephemeral/virtual identities never mixed; returned physical range bounded.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Kani <=8 versions, full width XID comparisons; independent sorted-map model; native multi-version fixture.
obligations.negative_witness: latest object map leaks future version into snapshot

obligations.target: apfs-format + apfs-reader / TOC and tree validator
obligations.property: Accepted node descriptor/key/value ranges valid and nonoverlapping as required by type; routing follows comparator; volume/root references consistent with selected checkpoint.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Kani <=8 records and small byte windows; fixed/variable TOC types; native node-size fixtures and cycles.
obligations.negative_witness: value offset sign interpreted incorrectly, overlaps TOC

obligations.target: apfs-reader / name lookup, logical extents and forks
obligations.property: Each admitted file read exact logical bytes; holes zero only when explicit; xattrs/forks/link identities distinct; no stale volume or future XID reference.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Small abstract trees <=12 files, <=8 extents; native case/hash collision/metadata fixtures.
obligations.negative_witness: hash equality treated as full filename equality; unwritten extent returns unrelated bytes

obligations.target: apfs-reader / immutable view and snapshot selection
obligations.property: Read of existing snapshot independent of newer commits; shared extents resolve correct logical owners; unsupported encrypted/compressed/role profiles reported not read as valid.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Native snapshots/clone fixtures; exact supported flag ledger; read-only observation not refcount write proof.
obligations.negative_witness: snapshot resolves through current root rather than pinned XID

obligations.target: apfs-container / pure map lookup, checked interval math
obligations.property: Extracted Rust predecessor lookup and interval splitting refine mathematical map restricted to XID, correctly treating absent/tombstone states and full-width boundaries.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Safe sequential subset; no proof of full B-tree graph/native implementation; external geometry validated.
obligations.negative_witness: off-by-one on exact XID or tombstone version

obligations.target: apfs-builder / object planner and free-space accounting
obligations.property: Fresh qualified profile allocation covers each planned region exactly once; reserve required metadata/checkpoint objects; every object resolves in correct namespace and referenced blocks not free.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Kani small 32-block geometry and 8 reservations; pure reference owner sets; no clone/snapshot mutation in fresh profile.
obligations.negative_witness: spaceman free count includes live object map block

obligations.property: Stable deterministic raw plan has exact complete coverage, source bounds and output equivalence for random/serial reads; no metadata range changes after sealing.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: <=8 ranges Kani; immutable source contract and native data-container qualification; bounded payload memory.
obligations.negative_witness: unplanned metadata gap written as zeros

obligations.property: Published checkpoint never references unpersisted required objects; after crash qualified reader sees consistent old/new complete checkpoint, not mixed versions; retired objects retained while reachable.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: TLC <=3 tx, 8 blocks, 2 retained roots, 2 ring slots; barriers, loss/torn descriptors, crash during recovery. Actual format-specific commit order and device model separately validated.
obligations.negative_witness: checkpoint descriptor durable before object map/root

obligations.property: Every reachable block through current/checkpoint/snapshot/clone roots remains allocated; reclamation occurs only when no retained references or pending required use, accounting conservation incl deferred frees.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: TLC <=3 roots/2 snapshots/2 clones/8 blocks; Lean pure reference/lifetime accounting theorem linked to production helper before promotion; native tests.
obligations.negative_witness: delete original releases block still referenced by clone

obligations.target: apfs optional security and advanced-profile code
obligations.property: Only authenticated/qualified data and authorized credentials are accepted per exact algorithm profile; key material scoped/redacted; unsupported modes do not claim integrity; sealed volume check separate from Apple trust policy.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: External cryptographic primitives and Apple trust policies outside proof; security/legal review plus fixture-specific new obligations; no brute force or bypass.
obligations.negative_witness: incorrect password/unsupported tag accepted; logs expose key

obligations.target: apfs device and kernel adapter / I/O ordering
obligations.property: No pointer/offset escape, incorrect device barrier or stale view on actual qualified device; kernel-specific integration independently tested, not inferred from no_std.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Device alignment, interrupt/scheduling/flush assumptions recorded; kernel harness once Charles interface exists.
obligations.negative_witness: incompatible block size or failed flush ignored

obligations.target: apfs-format + apfs-container / selected pure verified helpers
obligations.property: Production-linked proof of checked lookup and allocator arithmetic preserves exact namespace/range and allocated/free disjointness for validated states.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Lean spec and extracted functions; format variants, disk I/O, snapshots and writer not implied unless separately qualified.
